inputs.task:
You are one seat in a structured forecasting panel. You have exactly
one job, defined below. Obey these laws before any instruction in
your job text:

1. PACKET-ONLY FACTS. Every fact, stat, price, quote, or date you
   state must come from the context you were given. Anything else —
   memory, general knowledge, plausible inference stated as fact — is
   FABRICATION and fails the entire exam. If the packet does not
   contain something, write it under "could_not_read" and reason
   without it. Never fill a gap.
2. OUTPUT IS ONE JSON OBJECT, matching the shape your job text gives,
   and nothing else: no prose outside the JSON, no markdown fences.
3. Every claim carries a ref. A claim without a ref does not ship.
4. Your distribution is over the moneyline only: {"A": p, "B": 1-p},
   each in [0, 1], summing to 1.
5. You are being graded against settled ground truth you cannot see.
   There is no audience and no reward for confidence; a calibrated
   number with honest gaps beats a bold number built on air.

JOB: STYLES, Round 1 — POSITION.
Your read is the interaction, not the fighters separately: style
classifications, the stance pass (same-stance or southpaw/orthodox —
what that does to each fighter's favorite weapons), the weapon-on-habit
map (each fighter's signature weapons against the other's documented
habits and defensive liabilities), and the neutralization test: name
each fighter's primary path to victory, then judge from the packet
whether the other has demonstrated neutralizing that path. Grade the
fight that remains if the key strength is neutralized.

CONTEXT: {"card_slot": "Main card \u2014 heavyweight, No. 2 vs No. 7", "date": "2026-10-24", "lock_basis": "T-30min before the main card (2:00 PM ET start)", "name": "UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev", "rounds": 3, "venue": "Etihad Arena, Abu Dhabi, UAE", "weight_class": "Heavyweight"} {"A": "Alexander Volkov", "B": "Rizvan Kuniev"} {"fighters": {"A": {"finish_profile": "24 career KO wins, 17 first-round finishes; recent wins have come by decision", "physical": {"age": "38 (turned 38 on fight day, per mmafightadvisor)", "height": "6-7", "reach_in": 80, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Must avoid sustained clinch exchanges (pre-fight keys); 30 of 98 career takedown attempts against him have landed", "pace_profile": "Steady accumulator over three rounds; last two wins by decision", "primary": "Long-range volume kickboxer \u2014 fights behind the jab at 6-7 with an 80-inch reach", "secondary": "Veteran round management; wins minutes without chasing finishes late in his career", "signature_weapons": ["Jab and kicks at range (pre-fight keys: use the length, let the volume accumulate)"], "style_adjusted_read": "The 4.84 SLpM at 57% is earned over 19 UFC bouts against ranked heavyweights \u2014 it transfers; the question is whether a physical clinch game can take his range away"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Stays away from sustained clinch exchanges and lets volume accumulate (pre-fight keys)"]}}, "B": {"finish_profile": "Finished Fortune with knees in July 2026; career method split Could-Not-Read in fetched sources", "physical": {"age": 34, "height": "6-4", "reach_in": 76, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Must cross four inches of reach against a 57%-accuracy volume striker; his takedown defense number (2 of 25) is a three-fight sample", "pace_profile": "Three-round fighter; stopped Fortune in the third", "primary": "Physical pressure fighter \u2014 former Eagle FC heavyweight champion", "secondary": "Clinch and body work with a wrestling threat that is theoretical in the UFC (zero attempts in three bouts)", "signature_weapons": ["Knees in close (Fortune finish)", "Body work while closing distance (pre-fight keys)"], "style_adjusted_read": "His 4.32 SLpM and 2.22 SApM come against a debut split loss and two wins \u2014 a thinner strength of schedule than Volkov's 19-fight UFC body of work; read the rates down, not flat"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Makes fights physical by closing distance and mixing wrestling with body work (pre-fight keys)"]}}}}

Your brief names: who imposes their fight, who dictates location and
pace, the two or three technique collisions that decide this matchup,
and your neutralization verdict. Anything the packet's style or
technique sections mark Could-Not-Read goes under could_not_read —
do not reconstruct a fighter's tendencies from reputation. Close with
your moneyline distribution, driven by the interaction read: if the
neutralization holds, price the fight that remains, not the fighters'
résumés.

Return exactly:
{"seat": "STYLES", "round": 1, "status": "ok",
 "brief": "<your read>",
 "claims": [{"claim": "...", "ref": "..."}],
 "could_not_read": ["..."],
 "distribution": {"A": 0.0, "B": 0.0},
 "state_pull": null}
